title: FitResQ POST /refund-requests API Gateway Route Specification

routes.description: Customer refund request submission directly writing to FitResQCases & FitResQSLA
CORS preflight handling for web browsers

awsConsoleDeploymentSteps: Step 1 (Lambda): In AWS Console > Lambda (ap-south-1) > Create Function 'FitResQCreateRefundRequest' > Node.js 20.x > x86_64.
Step 2 (Code): Upload 'backend/dist/fitresq-create-refund-request.zip' (or copy index.mjs directly into the code editor).
Step 3 (Configuration): Under Environment variables, add AWS_REGION=ap-south-1, CASES_TABLE=FitResQCases, SLA_TABLE=FitResQSLA, AUDIT_TABLE=FitResQAudit, ORDERS_TABLE=FitResQOrders.
Step 4 (IAM Permission): Under Configuration > Permissions > Execution role, attach a policy with dynamodb:PutItem on FitResQCases, FitResQSLA, FitResQAudit, and dynamodb:GetItem on FitResQOrders.

Step 5 (API Gateway): In API Gateway Console > HTTP API 'qhk28b7ud2' > Routes > Create 'POST /refund-requests' and 'OPTIONS /refund-requests' pointing to Lambda integration 'FitResQCreateRefundRequest'.
